Comment: Phase 8: S3 arrival -> validate -> crawl -> ETL -> notify. Orchestrates the existing Phase 2 crawler and Phase 3 ETL; builds no new pipeline.

ValidateFile.Comment: A Choice, not a Lambda. The three checks the brief asks for are all expressible against the event the EventBridge rule delivers, so a function would add a runtime to evaluate three conditions.

IgnoredFile.Comment: Not a failure. An object that does not match is simply not this pipeline's input, and paging someone about it would train them to ignore the alert.

Retry.Comment: CrawlerRunningException is the transient case that actually happens here - two uploads close together. EntityNotFound is not retried: a missing crawler will still be missing in two seconds.

WaitForCrawler.Comment: startCrawler returns immediately, so the workflow polls. Thirty seconds because a crawl of this lake takes about 45; polling faster would just bill more GetCrawler calls to learn the same thing.

CrawlerFinished.Comment: READY means the crawl stopped, not that it worked - so the last crawl's own status is checked before the ETL is allowed to start. This is the dependency the brief asks for: ETL must not begin on a catalog the crawler failed to update.

RunGlueETL.Comment: .sync blocks until the job reaches a terminal state, so no polling loop is needed here - the Glue integration provides what the crawler API does not.

Retry.Comment: Transient service errors only. A data or logic failure is deterministic - retrying it bills three times to fail three times, and Phase 3 set max_retries=0 on the job itself for the same reason.

Parameters.Subject: retail pipeline: succeeded
Parameters.Message.$: States.Format('Arrival {} ({} bytes) crawled and processed. The ETL routes valid rows to curated/ and rejected rows to quarantine/ with a reason; see its reconciliation in CloudWatch.', $.key, $.size)

NotifyFailure.Comment: Every Catch lands here, so one notification path covers crawler, status and ETL failures alike.

PipelineFailed.Comment: The execution must end failed after notifying, or a caught error would report success and the console history would be misleading.
PipelineFailed.Cause: A stage failed after its retries were exhausted. See the notification and the execution history.
